meta.name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
meta.description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云端自动化实验室运行生物实验流程。
copy.tagline_en: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run automated lab experiments on a cloud platform.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你从 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 的实验目录中挑选协议（如蛋白表达纯化、RNA 合成等），说明每种协议的输入文件、价格和周期，并指导你完成订购。它也能用 EstiMate 评估自定义实验方案的可行性和报价。
howto.when: 当用户提到想要进行蛋白表达与纯化、RNA 合成、荧光像素画等实验，或直接说要使用 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 时触发。

say.text: 我想做无细胞蛋白表达验证，费用多少？
say.note: 会返回对应协议的价格和周期。

say.text: 帮我用 EstiMate 评估一个自定义的 SPR 实验。
say.note: 会引导你描述方案并给出可行性评估。
会说明像素画协议的价格和输入要求。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you pick protocols from Ginkgo Cloud Lab, explains inputs, pricing, and turnaround, and guides ordering. It also uses EstiMate to evaluate custom protocol feasibility and pricing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention protein expression/purification, RNA synthesis, fluorescent pixel art, or other Ginkgo Cloud Lab experiments, or ask to use the cloud lab directly.

say_en.text: I want cell-free protein expression validation. How much does it cost?
Use EstiMate to evaluate a custom SPR experiment.
say_en.note: Guides you to describe the protocol and get a feasibility assessment.

say_en.text: How do I order fluorescent pixel art?
say_en.note: Explains price and input requirements for the pixel art protocol.
